flags.message: Decisive forward signal from outside the provisioned record: the companion petition Hall v. Fleming (No. 26-193, same respondent, same Locke v. Davey question) has its brief in opposition due 2026-10-14 after an extension and thirteen amicus briefs, and the Fourth Circuit appeal underlying this cert-before-judgment petition (No. 26-1437) remains undecided with argument tentatively set for December 2026. Both predate the snapshot and shaped the forecast; neither reveals this petition's disposition.

The statpack publishes no cut for a Court-requested response after a respondent waiver, which is the strongest docket signal on this record (Oct 5, 2026 entry). The adjustment from the 5.0% baseline band anchor rests on judgment rather than a committed rate; a response-requested cut on the paid scored segment would make this class of cell anchorable.
